title: Prophet Yahweh summons UFO for TV crew
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Prophet Yahweh summons UFO for TV crew, about 1980s-1990s at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The prophet Yahweh was a fellow who lived in Las Vegas back in the day when I lived there, as a matter of fact, and he also claimed he could summon UFOs.
